events.text: Micky van de Ven (Tottenham Hotspur) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Nico González (Newcastle United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Tottenham Hotspur 0, Newcastle United 0.
Goal! Tottenham Hotspur 0, Newcastle United 1. Anthony Elanga (Newcastle United) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Amar Dedic with a headed pass.
Substitution, Tottenham Hotspur. Mikey Moore replaces Archie Gray.
Substitution, Tottenham Hotspur. Destiny Udogie replaces Andy Robertson.
Substitution, Tottenham Hotspur. Mohammed Kudus replaces Mathys Tel.
Substitution, Newcastle United. Nick Woltemade replaces Joe Willock.
Substitution, Newcastle United. Sean Steur replaces Nico González.

Goal! Tottenham Hotspur 0, Newcastle United 2. Yoane Wissa (Newcastle United) right footed shot from the left side of the six yard box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Nick Woltemade following a corner.
Substitution, Tottenham Hotspur. Dominic Solanke replaces Sandro Tonali.
Sven Botman (Newcastle United) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Newcastle United. Jacob Ramsey replaces Yoane Wissa.
Substitution, Newcastle United. Jacob Murphy replaces Anthony Elanga.
Substitution, Newcastle United. Bazoumana Touré replaces Harvey Barnes.
Second Half ends, Tottenham Hotspur 0, Newcastle United 2.
